title: hello there i'm new and have too much time on my hands

posts.author: slimehalo
posts.body:
a series of events happened and i have found myself unemployed and living hours away from friends and oceans away from family. i've owned rpg maker mv for a long time and never opened it, now i finally have a reason to. 25 hours of playtime later i found out there's forums and a whole community! so here i am.
i'm a visual artist first and foremost, but i've been learning to do pixel art (like my icon!) and chiptunes. at the moment i don't really have a "game" yet, i've just got a bunch of maps where i've messed around with drawing my own tilesets and experimented with events and music and transitions and things.
i've always loved turn based games. my favorite genre is the traditional turn based roguelike, but i also love a good rpg. it's honestly giving me more respect for the genre i already loved trying to figure out how to balance combat in a way that's engaging, instead of feeling like a nuisance. it's way harder than i thought.
